fields.System.Title: FDN-401 — Log every write with actor and correlation ID
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor investigating a discrepancy, I want every change recorded with who made
it and when, so that "who touched this?" is always answerable.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given any request that changes data, then an audit row is written with the actor,
  • timestamp, endpoint, entity, and correlation ID.
  • - Given a request that is rejected, then the attempt is still audited with its outcome.
  • - Given an audit row, then it can never be updated or deleted.
  • - Given a business transaction that rolls back, then the audit reflects the attempt and
  • its failure.
  • - Given a request body containing a secret, then the secret is not stored in the audit
  • row.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | audit_log |
| Risks | Some write path bypasses audit; audit writes slowing hot scanner paths ([doc 04 §3.1](../../../docs/04-modules.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · performance (confirm endpoint latency) |
